content: The farmer protects the young seedling with a fence until it grows into a mighty banyan tree; guard your early spiritual habits.
author: Kabir
explanation: All genuine greatness gestates in quiet, unnoticed obscurity. Do not seek premature fame; build deep roots in silence and discipline.
practicalInsight: Focus on your quiet daily craftsmanship today without worrying about public visibility.
reflectionPrompt: Am I willing to do the deep, quiet work in the dark before seeking the sun?
